decisions.reason: The firm built an entire multi-model product line for minimum quantity lubrication and gave it its own web page, so the investment and visible commitment are substantial, and any weak results can be blamed on the temporary pandemic slump in machine-tool demand.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter extends the firm's core filtration platform and was publicly presented, so dropping it would write off development effort in the firm's central business while the expanding firm can still attribute any shortfall to cyclical causes.

The gravity band filter sits close to the established coolant filtration offer, so it costs little to keep within the modular range, and its public presentation makes the firm reluctant to admit a mistake while market conditions are recovering.
